data.name: Ghaffara
data.gender_notes: Ghaffara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root ‘ghafara’ which means ‘to cover or conceal’. In the Islamic context, it refers to the one who covers or forgives sins. It is also mentioned in the Quran as a name for one of the virtuous female companions of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Ghaffara carries the meaning “Forgetter of Sins” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaffara usually hope their child will grow to embody forgetter of sins and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaffara total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
